name: Niji o Mitsuketara Oshiete.
original_name: 虹を見つけたら教えて。
source:
Main character is a medical student who wants to be a surgeon. As it rains, he meets an innocent girl Sui looking for a bridge across the rainbow in a group of five friends.
The five people gathered spontaneously have various relations problems. Is there a rainbow behind the clouds?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名立志成为外科医生的医学生。下雨时，他与五名朋友一同遇见了天真的少女翠，她正在寻找一座跨越彩虹的桥。
这五个自然而然聚到一起的人，各自面临不同的人际关系问题。云层背后真的有彩虹吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
